summary: Kerb on a busy Clarence Road bend with no parking and homes close.
reasons: Through road, no cars parked on kerb

drivers.seclusion: Summit View apartments 12 m at 21 m; houses and terraces overlooking the kerb to the west.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow verge and fence line beside a sealed carriageway; no lay-by or parking lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road beside a signalled junction with a clear markings.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the private apartment driveway, not along the kerb.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; tree shade from the west side in the late afternoon.

best_section.where: Clarence Road west kerb, south of the Summit View driveway
